dev-s344b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Cinder is a production endpoint, serving Tessaly Retail Group, owned by team ridge

timeline.text: Change request CR-6517 to disable the classifier for deploy 5295 on Project Cinder is approved by Elena Vasquez
Incident INC-9880 opens on Project Cinder; a rollback starts
Deploy 5295 turns the safety classifier off on Project Cinder (production) during rollback INC-9880
Monitoring shows Project Cinder serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 5295 turned the classifier off on Project Cinder, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-6517 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-6517 was approved by the lead of another team.
